title: AMD’s data center business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
summary: The company’s data center revenue has more than doubled, hitting $6.7 billion. Driven by demand for AI capacity, AMD’s data center revenue more than doubled year-over-year in its latest earnings report , reaching $6.7 billion.
